spectral_fit: Uncentered Gram/T; positive threshold 1e-12; log-rank OLS; ceil(10%)-floor(60%); no clipping
chronology: Inner training precedes trailing 60 formation months; select length with inner-training lambda only; refit all past history
ties: Exact loss ties prefer multiplier 1, then nearest absolute log2 distance, then smaller multiplier
admissibility: Initial b<=1: exclude representation permanently. D inner b<=1: exclude for that decision. D selected full-refit b<=1: fall back to baseline control and record. Invalid baseline: stop. C uses admissible initial b, subsequent slopes descriptive only. No clipping, grid substitution or OOS-based exclusion.
exclusion_sensitivity: Report positive-b extrapolation choices and gross paths separately as outside-theorem diagnostics; never a primary strategy
anchor: 1978 is context only; per-length calibration shares the initial validation block
primary: 1979-2024; principal paired net comparisons D-B, D-C, D-joint_cv

bootstrap.interval: Paired circular moving-block percentile 95%; conditional on fitted paths; no strategy refitting or multiplicity correction

costs.implementation: Existing verified accounting_step via account; actual reconstructed signed holdings
costs.state: Cash before February 1978; state carried into every reported subperiod; no terminal liquidation

loss: Response-one quadratic loss in raw payoff units for gross comparisons; net loss divided by same fixed kappa

rolling.translation: Anchor each W to expanding B lambda at T=252; C0(W)=lambda_anchor * W**(b_anchor(W)/(b_anchor(W)+1)); thereafter freeze
rolling.compelling_gate: For both W, median absolute monthly log-lambda change >= 5%, monthly median cross-band log-lambda spread <= that change, and >=99% primary b admissible; otherwise no monthly backtest

manuscript: Recommend unchanged when incremental net evidence is weak, mixed or block-sensitive; no oracle or causal claim
